notes: Federated personalized learning: 100 clients, 10 local epochs x 10 rounds, confidence-based clustering (at most C clusters). Booleanization of the images is never described. Clause scope unknown ('300 clauses'). Accuracy is averaged over clients/clusters (Sec. 6.4), not over repeated runs. Whether the 30k/15k/15k sample counts are totals or per client is ambiguous. Table 3 lists FedTM's non-IID scheme as Dirichlet. Abstract says 5 baselines, Sec. 1 says 6 (FLIS DC/HC counted separately). Record split field 'train' on communication-cost rows is a convention, not from the paper.
